integrity: A symbolic rank-stratum argument proves all prime-power cases. Exhaustive executable checks for ten finite fields, including nonprime fields, and direct action-orbit checks for three fields are corroborative rather than a general proof. Historical parametrizations are explicitly credited; no independence or external validation is asserted.
limitations: The theorem concerns the full base-field-linear substitution automorphism group of the unital length-five local algebra only. It does not classify higher jet orders, conjugacy classes, or semilinear actions; some recent potentially related preprints were available only by abstract.
title: Fixed-space and element-orbit spectra of fourth-order substitution jets
